title: German troops defeat the Herero at the Battle of Waterberg
summary: German colonial forces under Lothar von Trotha attacked the Herero at the Waterberg plateau and drove survivors into the Omaheke desert, where many died of thirst.
reason: The Herero had risen against German land seizures and abuses in German South West Africa, and von Trotha sought their destruction.
significance: It began the Herero and Nama genocide, often called the first genocide of the twentieth century.
